title: Release cutover checklist — 2026-03-09 (scratchpad)
content:
Context / purpose:
- Cutover for 2026-03-09 minor release (hotfix + small feature). Mostly infra + API throttling fixes.
- This is my personal scratchpad — final runbook will be in Confluence (see linked runbook).

Priority items (must do before GO):
- [ ] Verify canary cluster health (k8s: canary-1) — check pods, restarts, error rates
- [ ] Ensure backports applied to release branch and CI green (BACKPORT-789, REL-2026-45)
- [ ] Coordinate DB migration window with SRE (no schema changes expected)
- [ ] Prepare rollback plan and feature flags for immediate disable

Backport / PR status:
- platform PR #4521 — merged to main, awaiting backport to release/2026-03 (assigned to @Jordan)
  - backport branch: release/2026-03-backport-4521
  - Jenkins job: rel-backport-4521 (watch for flaky test 'kv-cache-test')
- BACKPORT-789: manual patch applied to release branch, need verification in staging (rachel-staging)

Pre-cutover checklist (T-2h to T-15m):
- T-120m: Announce freeze in #release-coordination, tag on-call SRE (@oncall)
  Message template: "Cutover starting 2026-03-09 14:00 UTC. Expect ~15m of degraded perf. Contact #sre-oncall for incidents."
- T-90m: Run smoke tests on staging (scripts/ci/smoke-ci.sh) — attach logs to REL-2026-45
- T-60m: Run canary deploy (1 replica) to canary-1 cluster: 
  kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deploy/platform-api --context=canary-1
  kubectl get pods -n redwood -w --context=canary-1 (watch for CrashLoopBackOff)
- T-30m: Validate telemetry dashboards (Grafana: release/2026-03-dashboard)
- T-15m: Final thumbs-up from product & SRE in #release-coordination

Cutover steps (GO at 14:00 UTC):
1) Disable autoscaler for target pool (temporary) — infra command in runbook
2) Deploy release tag to prod (rolling):
   - git checkout release/2026-03-backport-4521
   - ./deploy/deploy-release.sh --tag v2026.03.09-hotfix --strategy rolling
3) Watch deploy: kubectl rollout status deploy/platform-api -n prod --timeout=10m
4) Run smoke endpoint tests after each AZ rollout (scripts/ops/smoke-prod.sh)
5) Re-enable autoscaler once all healthy

Post-deploy verification (T+5m to T+60m):
- Check error rates (Sentry project: platform-prod) — look for spike >2x baseline
- Check latency p50/p95 in Datadog (dash: /d/plat/latency-release-2026-03)
- Verify token billing metrics and request rates (Console -> Metrics -> per-route)
- Pull a few sample inference requests through hosted-api and verify outputs (spot check)

Rollback criteria / quick steps:
- If 5xx rate > 1% sustained for 5m OR latency p95 > 2x baseline for 10m -> initiate rollback
- Quick rollback: 
  - ./deploy/rollback-to-tag.sh --tag v2026.03.08-stable
  - reopen autoscaler if we had disabled it earlier
  - notify #release-coordination and #sre-oncall

Comms checklist:
- Pre-GO: post in #release-coordination with ETA and expected impact
- GO: post status update (start + expected duration)
- Post: summary + any follow-ups + links to incident tickets if issues
- Customers: if degradation > 30m, prepare email template (CS to review)

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Jordan: can you confirm Jenkins backport job is green? (assigned)
- Samira: please sanity-check the feature flag default for throttling change
- Need to add smoke test for KV-cache eviction scenario — quick ticket? (file REL-2026-46)

Notes to self:
- Remember to stamp final upload in Confluence with timestamp + logs
- If anything weird in CI, grab full logs: /var/ci/logs/rel-backport-4521
- Walkthrough with Mateo tomorrow for post-mortem template

Quick commands cheat sheet:
- kubectl --context=prod -n redwood rollout status deploy/platform-api
- gcloud compute instances tail-serial-port-logs <instance> --zone=<zone> (for legacy infra)
- ./scripts/ops/smoke-prod.sh --endpoint /v1/infer --count 20

-- rachel
